title: Every State citation and penalty at the 79 homes, 2023 to 2026, and whether it is final
question: Which State citations at these homes stand as final, and which are still under appeal?
finding: 166 State actions at the 79 homes, 2023 to 2026 to date: 86 citations and 80 administrative penalties. 23 citations of class AA or A; 17 of them not appealed or with the appeal closed, 6 under appeal. 13 actions in all are appealed and still open. Garfield Neurobehavioral Center: 3 citations, all appealed and open (class B 2025-04-15 $3,000; class A 2025-10-23 $25,000; class AA 2025-11-24 $75,000).
how: Every row of each home's enforcement table (Cal Health Find, 2023 to 2026 to date). "Not appealed": the row says Appealed No; "appeal closed": appealed and the disposition reads Closed; "under appeal": appealed and still Open. Class is the class first assessed and, where the site gives it, the final class.
limits: An action still open to appeal has not been upheld and may be reduced or dismissed; "Open" can also mean a penalty not yet paid. Nursing-hours penalties (DHPPD) are assessed on days below the State's staffing minimum and carry no class. The table gives no findings text.
